cs.t: I use a pair of skull candy titans at work(they are ear buds, but some of the best I have tried.) They do a good job of passive noise cancellation and have inline volume controls. The nook ear buds are also really good(they come with 5 different size covers if the reason you don't like your current ear buds is fit.) At home I use skull candy Hesh headphones which I rather like, but I wouldn't bring them to work as they are a bit garish.
cs.th: Ask HN:  What type of headphones do you use at work?
